name: Liechtenstein performance-related heavy vehicle fee (LSVA, as in Switzerland)
law: Schwerverkehrsabgabeverordnung (SVAV) of 3 December 2024, LGBl. 2024 Nr. 452, Art. 7 para. 1: 3.26 / 2.82 / 2.39 Rappen per tonne-km for fee categories 1 / 2 / 3; Annex: EURO VI in category 3; Art. 5 para. 3: chargeable weight at most 40 t.

sources.title: Liechtenstein SVAV, LGBl. 2024 Nr. 452, consolidated version of 1 October 2025

vehicles: Motor vehicles and trailers over 3.5 t total weight used for goods transport, Swiss or foreign
tolled_roads: All public roads: the fee is per km driven anywhere in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

exemptions.note: Motor vehicles with electric drive are exempt, as in Switzerland (SVAG Art. 5 para. 1 let. i).
